edbDesc: For a solid object travelling through a fluid (or alternatively a stationary object exposed to a moving fluid) flow separation occurs when the boundary layer travels far enough against an adverse pressure gradient that the speed of the boundary layer falls almost to zero.The fluid flow becomes detached from the surface of the object, and instead takes the forms of eddies and vortices.
title: Flow Separation
pickWhy: Follows Boundary layer, which was dropped as a concept rather than an effect.
